title: The cruiserweights’ final tag-team chase
summary: A new championship gives WCW’s cruiserweights a fresh team competition just before the company’s sale. Kidman and Mysterio chase the inaugural champions into the final Nitro.

chapters.title: Skipper and Romeo win the tournament
chapters.result: Skipper and Romeo defeat Kidman and Mysterio for the inaugural Cruiserweight Tag Team titles.
chapters.context: The tournament creates a new prize for the division in WCW’s last pay-per-view.

chapters.title: Kidman and Rey win the final rematch
chapters.result: Kidman and Mysterio defeat Skipper and Romeo for the titles.
chapters.context: The challengers gain the belts on the final night of WCW’s independent television history.
